{{Quote|The ones Commander Dauntarist just showed us, you malfunctioning little twerp!|C-D20 reminds R2-RD which starship database to show Rebel agents|<ref name="ABGTAS" />}}
'''Dauntarist''' was an individual who reached the rank of [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. At one stage during their time as commander, Dauntarist showed the [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droid]] [[C-D20]] and its [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[Counterpart/Legends|counterpart]] [[R2-RD]] a database of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] models, available for use by Rebel [[Agent/Legends|agents]]. After being shown the database, both [[Droid/Legends|droids]] were stationed in a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] to inform agents of the ships they could choose from.<ref name="ABGTAS" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dauntarist was first mentioned in [[1995]] in the article "[[A Buyer's Guide to Alternative Starships]]" which was published in the [[Star Wars Adventure Journal 5|fifth]] issue of the ''[[Star Wars Adventure Journal]]'' series of supplement books for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' by [[West End Games]]. The article was written by [[Stephen Luminati]].<ref name="ABGTAS" />
